history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration expedite the integration of the meeting management system with the Umoja financial system to ensure that cancelled or postponed meetings are incorporated into the revenue adjustment process in accordance with the requirements of the International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS).
history.administration_response: To further strengthen the integration of the meeting management system with Umoja, the Department for General Assembly and Conference Management has collaborated with the Enterprise Resource Planning Solution Division and the finance functional subgroup to synchronize transactional data between Umoja and gMeets. The enhancement of gMeets functionality and the extrabudgetary workflow now enables more precise tracking of requested services and improved reporting on extrabudgetary meetings held, postponed or cancelled. In addition, extrabudgetary meeting policies and requester responsibilities are codified in the One- Stop Shop, requiring requesters to acknowledge the cancellation policy before submitting a meeting request. The integration of a unique identifier in both gMeets and Umoja links meeting requests to individual events, allowing the Department for General Assembly and Conference Management to effectively track revenue and refunds by reconciling Umoja financial data with meeting cancellations in gMeets.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has synchronized the transaction data between Umoja and gMeets, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
